migrations.description: Equivalent Context interaction roles consolidate onto the canonical primary and brand roles without keeping duplicate DTCG records.
Background status intensity uses primary and secondary names consistently in code, Catalog and Figma while the published default and strong paths remain compatible.
Published Context v1 paths remain readable while consumers migrate to the compact DTCG-safe v2 grammar.
The original role-oriented color API resolves to the current Context public API during the major-version migration window.
The original 50–1000 Primitive ramps and static color paths resolve to the compact authoring scale during the major-version migration window.
The color family is named Coral at the authoring layer; Brand remains a Semantic purpose rather than a Primitive family name.
